title: LLM gym
description: GPU implementations of language-model pieces in PyTorch: RMSNorm, SwiGLU and mixture-of-experts MLPs, LoRA, rotary embeddings, causal and grouped-query attention, KV-cache and paged-attention decode steps, cross-entropy, sampling filters, beam search, speculative decoding and the GRPO loss. Batched CUDA tensors, graded and benchmarked on your GPU, each with an editorial. The ML coding gym has CPU interview versions of several of them.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani et al., 2017)
sources.note: The transformer this gym takes apart.

sources.title: Root Mean Square Layer Normalization (Zhang and Sennrich, 2019)

FlashAttention (Dao et al., 2022)

sources.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration (Holtzman et al., 2019)
nanoGPT (Karpathy)
sources.note: A small, readable GPT where all of these pieces fit together.

sources.title: Mixtral of Experts (Jiang et al., 2024)

sources.title: GQA: Training Generalized Multi-Query Transformer Models (Ainslie et al., 2023)
